globalAlertExpr.description: The global alert expression for this datapoint

alertClearInterval.description: The interval of alert clear transition

disableAlerting.description: Whether or not alerting will be disabled for the datapoint

alertExprNote.description: The note associated with the current alert threshold settings

dataPointDescription.description: The description of the datapoint the alert settings apply to

dataSourceInstanceId.description: The id of the DataSource instance alert settings apply to

disableDpAlertHostGroups.description: The group full path lists who disable alert for this datapoint on devicegroup level

dataPointName.description: The name of the datapoint the alert settings apply to

dataPointId.description: The id of the Datapoint alert settings apply to

deviceGroupId.description: The ID of the device group

parentDeviceGroupAlertExprList.description: Device group alert expression list base on the priority. The first is the highest priority and effected on this instance

alertingDisabledOn.description: The datapoint is effected alert disabled by which group

id.description: The id of this alert setting

dataSourceInstanceAlias.description: The alias (name) of the DataSource instance the alert settings apply to

deviceGroupFullPath.description: The full path of the device group

alertExpr.description: The thresholds that should be associated with the datapoint. Note that you need to have a space between the operator and each threshold (e.g. > 1 2 3)
